issue_context.title: Tuya Integration giving cross-region error
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Unable to recreate Tuya integration with new setup. IoT platform set up as per instructions, but when I configure I get the error below.

My country code is 64, app is Tuya Smart, and validated these login details work in the old HA version. According to [this Tuya doc](https://developer.tuya.com/en/docs/iot/Platform_Configuration_smarthome?id=Kamcgamwoevrx) I should be using America region which I am - specifically "Western America" looks to the region my devices are associated to in the IoT console.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2020.10.0b1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2021.9.7

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

tuya

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://rc.home-assistant.io/integrations/tuya/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
2021-10-01 19:30:22 DEBUG (SyncWorker_1) [homeassistant.components.tuya.config_flow] TuyaConfigFlow._try_login finish, response:, {'code': 2007, 'msg': 'your ip(x.x.x.x) cross-region access is not allowed', 'success': False, 't': 1633069822521}
```


### Additional information

_No response_
comments:
Hey there @tuya, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`tuya`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L547) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

---

[tuya documentation](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/tuya)
[tuya source](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/tree/dev/homeassistant/components/tuya)
<sub><sup>(message by IssueLinks)</sup></sub>

@ZephireNZ Thanks for the feedbacks! To help us investigate the issue, could you help to provide more Home Assistant log to us? You can follow this tutorial to get the log:  [How to get thw log](https://github.com/tuya/tuya-home-assistant/wiki/How-to-Get-the-Log?_source=f75a22f47cc75545545c239077c07e53) , thanks!

Hiya,

The logging mentioned above is the only thing logged. Using the below logger config, the below is all that shows in the log (IP masked as `x.x.x.x` for privacy):

```
2021-10-02 22:15:27 DEBUG (SyncWorker_5) [homeassistant.components.tuya.config_flow] TuyaConfigFlow._try_login finish, response:, {'code': 2007, 'msg': 'your ip(x.x.x.x) cross-region access is not allowed', 'success': False, 't': 1633166145543}
```

FYI your docs refer to the old logging name for custom component, I am using below logger config (I included the Tuya python modules just in case there was extra from them but no luck):

```yaml
logger:
  default: critical
  logs:
    tuya_iot: debug
    tuya-iot-py-sdk: debug
    homeassistant.components.tuya: debug
    homeassistant.components.tuya.config_flow: debug
```

Settings I used:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1644496/135710539-77980386-3f7c-4735-8fb7-819033c2e760.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1644496/135710525-b0d38010-d6c9-4f9c-815c-eb6183fffd74.png)

I'm getting the same in the UK using a country code of 44. The page linked to above says that the UK is associated with the Europe availability region. However, I see two regions, Western Europe and Central Europe and my devices are under Central Europe.
Some issue here, from Tuya Developer platform Global error Codes (https://developer.tuya.com/en/docs/iot/error-code?id=K989ruxx88swc), 2007 is "device token expired".

I've checked the code in the Tuya V2 custom integration against what has been released here, and found some code in config_flow.py in the custom component here:

https://github.com/tuya/tuya-home-assistant/blob/master/custom_components/tuya_v2/config_flow.py#L90

which is not present here:

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/d3b1ccb66819988ec3131827bd2cdd649332b013/homeassistant/components/tuya/config_flow.py

That code uses either the China (https://openapi.tuyacn.com) or US (https://openapi.tuyaus.com) endpoints when logging on depending on whether the country code is China or not.

The code release in the beta here always uses the China endpoint.

I've tested this locally myself and it appears that it allows it to work for me in the UK.
Can confirm that above fix works for me too
Thanks @ZephireNZ @gadgetchnnel for locating the issue, we have created another PR to help fix it, please check if it helps. https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/56973

Hey team, after upgrading to 2021.10.4, I still have the problem.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11518567/136952344-46da5401-1480-463d-9a1d-bdd663f6b248.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11518567/136952422-102c443f-e5cf-4331-8594-812967cf0fed.png)

If I choose China the integration will not let me through. 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11518567/136953061-31892aaa-3c5d-4726-ba74-8245caed5c89.png)
Choosing Germany will fail in the above documented way.

It looks like your devices are registered in the China region, but you are in Germany.

If you check the Tuya app, what country is shown?

![IMG_853EDD88CCEB-1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11518567/137127844-1e438359-42e3-461b-b4a8-faca8cfb2d9c.jpeg)
I am not sure how I can exactly check that, but it shows Germany in the app. Can I somehow do something to move it over?
@StevusPrimus you probably want to raise a new issue for this one, if you haven't sorted it
Yes, I migrated the devices into the smart life app. Now it works.

review_comments:
What about the other regions?
Should everyone use America or china?
For me in Europe, "https://openapi.tuyaeu.com" worked great
I wonder if it makes sense to add `vol.Required(CONF_ENDPOINT): vol.In(TUYA_ENDPOINT),` to this schema as well?

Yeah I mentioned I was thinking the same on my PR.

Certainly the US endpoint should work for all but China, but makes sense to use closest where possible.
For now, it only limit the cross-region between China and other countries. For countries outside China,  no cross-region limitation. And will select the correct account region automatically.

```suggestion
COUNTRY_CODE_CHINA = "86"
```

According to the documentation, this is the only valid code.
We add three array values to increase the fault tolerance, we don’t know what users will input. So will keep this code, no need to change it.
Country code is also sent to the server. Does the server not care? https://github.com/tuya/tuya-iot-python-sdk/blob/master/tuya_iot/openapi.py#L208-L216
The server will help handle the country code.
It’s an array, so it doesn’t make sence to chnage it to ==
